item_short_desc: Rothco’s MOLLE Utility Pouch is a versatile storage solution designed to accommodate small electronics, magazine rounds, and other essential gear. Constructed for durability, the pouch features a front flap secured by 2 side release buckles, along with a cinch cord and barrel lock adjuster to keep your items securely in place. This utility pouch can hold up to 6 30-round M4 magazines, making it a great option for range days or on-the-go organization. Measuring 8 inches x 8 inches x 2.5 inches, it provides ample space without being bulky.
description: Rothco’s MOLLE Utility Pouch is a versatile storage solution designed to accommodate small electronics, magazine rounds, and other essential gear. Constructed for durability, the pouch features a front flap secured by 2 side release buckles, along with a cinch cord and barrel lock adjuster to keep your items securely in place. This utility pouch can hold up to 6 30-round M4 magazines, making it a great option for range days or on-the-go organization. Measuring 8 inches x 8 inches x 2.5 inches, it provides ample space without being bulky. Whether you're storing electronics, tools, or other necessities, Rothco's MOLLE Utility Pouch ensures your gear stays accessible and protected.
